+def _replace_all(s, table):
+    """
+    Apply every (ps, c, a, b) replacement of table to s in order (ps == a + b).
+    Exact per-character counts of s are kept (a replacement of r occurrences
+    removes r of a and r of b, adds r of c), so replacements whose pair
+    cannot occur in s are skipped without scanning s: same result.
+    """
+    counts = {}
+    _count_elements(counts, s)
+    get = counts.get
+    for ps, c, a, b in table:
+        na = get(a)
+        if not na:
+            continue
+        if a == b:
+            if na < 2:
+                continue
+        elif not get(b):
+            continue
+        t = s.replace(ps, c)
+        r = len(s) - len(t)
+        if r:
+            s = t
+            counts[a] = na - r
+            counts[b] -= r
+            counts[c] = get(c, 0) + r
+    return s
